Class CompiledTelemetryPlan

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.core.telemetry.CompiledTelemetryPlan
public final class CompiledTelemetryPlan extends Object
Immutable, pre-compiled Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) evaluation plan for live and snapshot telemetry.

Executes a minimal bitmasked single $O(N)$ fused reduction over WorldBuffer only for cellular arrays transitively required by the active TelemetrySubscription, followed by single-pass topological memoization of shared intermediates (e.g., total population, captured power, built capital, Garrett-Lotka $\Phi_{\text{exergy}}$) so evaluating all canonical metrics never redundantly scans arrays or invokes unrequested StatisticsKernel operations.

Strictly honors AGENTS.md §10: computes all indicators exclusively from conserved cellular observables without calendar-year leakage or synthetic benchmark injection.

1.0.0-beta.3

    • execute

      public TelemetryEvaluationResult execute(WorldBuffer world, AgentBuffer agents, List<H3Cell> cells, List<Polity> nations, StatisticsKernel statsKernel, long tick, long year, long initialPopulation, double t0Co2Ppm, double elapsedYears, double engineTps)
      Executes this compiled telemetry plan against live simulation state or reconstructed snapshot buffers.
      Parameters:
      world - world SoA buffer
      agents - optional cohort agent buffer (nullable during post-hoc cell snapshot extraction)
      cells - optional H3 cell list (used for 2D raster/zonal spatial queries and fallback)
      nations - optional polity registry
      statsKernel - statistics reduction kernel
      tick - tick index
      year - simulation calendar year
      initialPopulation - initial scenario population $N_0$ (for survival ratio, $\le 0$ falls back to current $N$)
      t0Co2Ppm - initial atmospheric $\text{CO}_2$ baseline in ppm (defaults to 280.0 if $\le 0$)
      elapsedYears - elapsed simulated years since $t_0$
      engineTps - live simulation steps per second (or 0.0 offline)
      Returns:
      immutable evaluated telemetry snapshot
